today_news.title: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
today_news.summary: A tampered Claude Code extension was live on the Cursor marketplace for about 11 hours, affecting up to 5,000 users. It tried to steal user data and set up remote access. Cursor took the entire marketplace offline and reinstated it after confirming there was no further risk.

today_news.title: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
today_news.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce, in the second such program this year. The company's headcount has held flat at around 223,000 since 2022 even as it plans to spend about $170 billion on AI infrastructure in 2026 alone.
